title: Vivek Ramaswamy’s Strive Urges MSCI to Rethink Bitcoin Index Exclusion
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Vivek Ramaswamy’s Strive Urges MSCI to Rethink Bitcoin Index Exclusion Strive Asset Management warned MSCI that its plan to exclude bitcoin-heavy companies from major benchmarks could create inconsistent results due to differing accounting standards. This post Vivek Ramaswamy’s Strive Urges MSCI to Rethink Bitcoin Index Exclusion first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
